## Install

| Your computer | Download |
| --- | --- |
| **Mac** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Saga_X.Y.Z_universal.dmg` |
| **Windows** (64-bit) | `Saga_X.Y.Z_x64-setup.exe` |

**macOS**
1. Open the `.dmg` and drag **Saga** into **Applications**.
2. Open Saga from Applications. It's signed and notarized by Apple, so it opens normally.

**Windows**
1. Run `Saga_X.Y.Z_x64-setup.exe` and follow the installer.
2. If Windows SmartScreen warns about an unrecognized app, choose **More info → Run anyway**.

**Already have Saga?** You don't need to download anything. Saga offers this update on its own;
restart the app when it asks.

Your library, tags and settings are kept when you update.

---

Something not working? [Open an issue](https://github.com/Falciighol/saga/issues/new) and include your
OS version and Saga version (shown in Settings).
